# Key Service Logic

| Service | Special behavior |
|---------|-----------------|
| ProjetService | Type validation, hierarchy cycle detection, cascade-delete livrables/assignments |
| LivrableService | Validates ownership: releaseId XOR projetId (not both) |
| ProjetLivrableAssignmentService | bulkReplace validates sum=100%, deleteByLivrableId cascade |
| ProduitLivrableAssignmentService | Same pattern for product context |
| ProjectPhaseService | Cascade-delete PhaseLivrables on phase deletion |
| MilestoneService | Cascade-delete MilestonePhases on milestone deletion |
| UserPreferenceService | Merges with defaults (language=en, dateFormat=dd/MM/yyyy), validates values |
